display.purpose: The "Para po!" line on the login brand panel; 72px on laptop.

headline.purpose: Screen titles ("Where to?", page headers); 28px on login and register.

figure-row.purpose: The fare in each vehicle row.

title.purpose: Empty-state titles (18px); sheet and dialog titles run 20px.

section.purpose: In-screen section heads such as "Choose a ride".

body-strong.purpose: Vehicle names and button labels; inputs use 16px semibold.

meta.purpose: Vehicle descriptors, dates, discount notes, fine print.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Place-search suggestion list and skip link: things floating over the page.

shadows.name: thumb
shadows.purpose: Active option of a segmented control or the admin section switch.

shadows.name: marker
shadows.purpose: Pickup and drop-off markers on the map.

shadows.name: selection-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected vehicle row and focused place field. A stroke, not elevation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default curve: press, row entrance, page slide, sheets, fills, route draw.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Long expo-out settle for the ride list rising and toast entrance.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Ride list on Plan; login form sheet.

motion.name: stagger-vehicle
motion.purpose: Gap between vehicle rows and between their fare count-ups.

motion.name: select-pop
motion.purpose: Vehicle row on selection; laptop dialog entrance.

motion.name: select-fill
motion.purpose: Mint fill and green ring growing into the selected row.

motion.name: route-draw
motion.purpose: Route line draws along its path.

motion.name: toast
motion.value: enter 220ms ease-settle translateY(12px) + fade; exit 140ms ease-out fade

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: keyframes become fades; press, fill growth, route draw and counting are removed.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one go action of a screen; pinned full-width above the tab bar at 56px on Plan.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #08744C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #08744C; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #065C3C; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #E8ECEA; color: #5F6670; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Gray-filled companion action; also the settled state of a pinned action ("Trip logged").
components.css: .ds-btn-s { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: #F2F4F3; color: #15181C; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-s:hover { background: #E8ECEA; } .ds-btn-s:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-s:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #08744C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet text action with no fill until touched, often in green.
components.css: .ds-btn-g { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: #08744C; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-g:hover { background: #F2F4F3; } .ds-btn-g:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-g:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #08744C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Gray-filled text field with a bold label; turns white with a green border on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #15181C; } .ds-field-input { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; background: #F2F4F3; color: #15181C; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; caret-color: #08744C; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #5F6670; font-weight: 500; opacity: 1; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: none; background: #FFFFFF; border-color: #08744C; } .ds-field-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: #B42318; background: #FDECEA; }

components.name: Vehicle Row
components.description: Signature quote row: glyph tile, name with Cheapest tag, descriptor, and the fare right-aligned with the struck regular fare. Shown selected.
components.css: .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-vrow { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 18px 16px; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #15181C; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-vrow:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-vrow:has(:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid #08744C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-vrow-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: 14px; background: #E7F4EE; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #08744C; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; opacity: 0.4; transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), opacity 200ms ease-out; } .ds-vrow[data-selected=true] .ds-vrow-fill { transform: scaleX(1); opacity: 1; } .ds-vrow-glyph { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #F2F4F3; } .ds-vrow[data-selected=true] .ds-vrow-glyph { background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-vrow-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-vrow-name { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-vrow-note { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #545B66; } .ds-vrow-fare { margin-left: auto; text-align: right; } .ds-vrow-price { display: block; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-vrow-reg { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #545B66; } .ds-tag-amber { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFB020; color: #3A2A00; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 20px; }

components.name: Tags
components.description: Plain status tags; amber only for Cheapest.
components.html: Cheapest Published Draft Error
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 20px; } .ds-tag-c { background: #FFB020; color: #3A2A00; } .ds-tag-g { background: #E7F4EE; color: #065C3C; } .ds-tag-n { background: #F2F4F3; color: #545B66; } .ds-tag-r { background: #FDECEA; color: #B42318; }

components.name: Route Strip
components.description: Slim strip sketching the real route that opens the map on phones.
components.css: .ds-strip { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; height: 64px; padding: 0 14px 0 0; overflow: hidden; border: none; border-radius: 14px; background: #E9EEE9; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-strip:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-strip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #08744C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-strip-svg { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; } .ds-strip-line { stroke-dasharray: 1 1; animation: ds-draw 800ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-draw { from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } } .ds-strip-label { position: relative; margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #065C3C; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-strip-line { stroke-dasharray: none; animation: ds-fade 180ms ease-out both; } @keyframes ds-fade { from { opacity: 0; } } }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Gray track with a white thumb; used for fare category, vehicle and admin section switches.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 4px; max-width: 384px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 14px; background: #F2F4F3; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-opt { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 11px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #545B66; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-seg-opt:hover { color: #15181C; } .ds-seg-opt:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-seg-on { background: #FFFFFF; color: #15181C; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(21,24,28,0.14); }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: Phone navigation; the same items become a 96px left rail at 1024px.
components.html: PlanTripsFares1Alerts
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; height: 64px; border-top: 1px solid #E6E8E7; background: #FFFFFF; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 56px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #545B66; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: #15181C; } .ds-tab:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #08744C; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-pill { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 28px; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background-color 200ms; } .ds-tab-on { color: #08744C; } .ds-tab-on .ds-tab-pill { background: #E7F4EE; } .ds-badge { position: absolute; top: -6px; right: -2px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #B42318; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview:
ParaPo quotes a cash jeepney fare the way a ride-hailing app quotes a ride: a pickup and drop-off stack, a slim sketch of the route, then one tall row per vehicle with its price right-aligned, compared at a glance. The ground is plain white, the type is one workhorse sans set heavy, and a single green carries everything that means "this one" or "go": the selected ride, the primary button, the route line, the active tab. Nothing is boxed for decoration. Rows sit on the white ground separated by space or hairlines, and only grouped inputs and the route strip sit on a pale gray tone.

The system is built at 390px first and reflows whole to the laptop: the same column docks at the left (440px on Plan) while the map fills the rest, and the bottom tab bar becomes a left rail. Density is generous and thumb-led: every target is at least 44px, primary actions pin above the tab bar, and type never drops below 11px (tab labels) with body copy at 15px.

Motion is quiet and physical: screens slide 12px up while fading in, prices count up to value one row after another, the selected row fills with green from the left, and the route draws itself along its path. Under reduced motion everything only fades. The system confirms two visual rejections: the generic SaaS dashboard (white cards, stat tiles, soft-shadow panels) and the dark neon "tech" look; and it must not return to bureaucratic-document metaphors or table-led fare answers.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, near-black ink, one brand green, amber reserved for the Cheapest tag.
One typeface (Manrope via next/font) with tabular figures everywhere.
Fares are extrabold tabular numerals, right-aligned, and lead their row.
Rows and hairlines, not cards; pale gray tone groups inputs.
One 14px corner on every control, row, strip and toast.
Phone tab bar becomes a laptop rail; the phone column docks left beside a permanent map.
Motion settles on long expo-out curves and never delays input; reduced motion fades only.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green means intent: selected, primary, route, active, link. It is never a decorative fill or a section background inside the app; the only full-green field is the login brand panel.

rules.name: The Earned Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber marks the single cheapest ride and nothing else. Draft matrices, warnings and estimates stay neutral gray; a second amber element on a screen breaks the rule.

rules.name: The Tabular Everywhere Rule
rules.body: `tnum` is on at the body. Never turn it off for an amount, a distance or a count.

rules.name: The Number Leads Rule
rules.body: An amount is always extrabold, ink, right-aligned in its row, and the heaviest element in its row or section. On Trips and Fares it is the largest type on the screen; on Plan the 30px "Where to?" title is larger than the 26px row fare, as the approved comp specifies.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, tags, headings and tabs are sentence case. The shipped system has no uppercase or letter-spaced labels and no small label set above a title.

rules.name: The Same Column Rule
rules.body: The laptop layout is the phone column docked beside a map, never a different arrangement of the same content.

rules.name: The Thumb Zone Rule
rules.body: The one primary action of a commuter screen is full-width and pinned above the tab bar, reachable by thumb.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is above the page." Rows, sections and panels at rest never carry one.

rules.name: The 14px Rule
rules.body: A new control, row or container uses 14px corners unless it nests inside one (step down) or is a sheet (step up).

dos: Do lead every commuter screen with the amount: extrabold, tabular, right-aligned, the heaviest element in its row.
Do keep green for intent (selected, primary, route, active, link) and amber for the single Cheapest tag.
Do group with the Surface Gray tone or a hairline; leave rows on the white ground.
Do use 14px corners for controls, rows, strips and toasts, stepping down inside them and up for sheets.
Do keep every target at least 44px and pin the screen's one primary action above the tab bar.
Do reflow the phone column whole for laptop: dock it, add the rail, give the map the rest.
Do draw icons from the one line family (1.75 stroke, round caps, currentColor) and reuse the pickup dot and drop-off square wherever a route appears.
Do stagger lists (40ms for vehicle rows, 30ms for other rows) and fall back to opacity-only fades under reduced motion.
Do show the working: matrix, effective date, distance, discount, and the "illustrative, not official" note beside seeded fares.
Do signal unread or selected state with more than colour (dot plus weight plus spoken text; ring plus fill).
donts: Don't build a SaaS dashboard: no white rounded cards, stat tiles or soft-shadow panels.
Don't use a dark neon "tech" look.
Don't return to bureaucratic-document metaphors (notices, stamps, forms) or answer a fare with a km-by-fare table.
Don't put amber on drafts, warnings or estimates; those stay neutral.
Don't set Connector Gray as text; it is for strokes only.
Don't shadow anything that does not float over the page.
Don't show a per-vehicle travel time or any figure ParaPo has no source for.
Don't present seeded fares as an official LTFRB fare guide.
Don't let motion delay input or exceed the opacity-only fallback under reduced motion.
